name: QR_Rule_01: Password Brute-Force & Account Lockout
description: Eyni menbeden 5 deqiqe icinde 5+ ugursuz giris (4625) ve ya hesabin kilidlenmesi (4740). Parol siyasetinin lockout haddine (5) qarsi brute-force cehdini askarlayir.
gpo_policy: Parol/lockout siyaseti - 5 xetali giris limiti, 15 deqiqe kilid
expression: SELECT sourceip, username, "Event ID", COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM events WHERE "Event ID"='4625' GROUP BY sourceip, username HAVING attempts>=5 LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test 1: 'Event ID' equals 4625 -> count >= 5 grouped by Source IP in 5 min. Test 2 (OR): 'Event ID' equals 4740. Response: Dispatch New Event, Ensure part of an offense indexed by Username/Source IP.

name: QR_Rule_02: New User Account Created
description: Yeni user hesabinin yaradilmasi (4720) ve/veya aktiv edilmesi (4722). Icaze verilmemis hesab yaradilmasini (persistence) askarlayir.
gpo_policy: Loglama siyaseti - Istifadeci idareetmeleri (user management) loglari aktiv
expression: SELECT username, "TargetUserName", "Event ID" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('4720','4722') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: 'Event ID' is any of 4720, 4722. Response: Dispatch New Event + Offense indexed by TargetUserName.

name: QR_Rule_03: User Added to Privileged/Administrators Group
description: Istifadecinin imtiyazli qrupa (Administrators/Domain Admins) elave edilmesi (4732 lokal, 4728 qlobal, 4756 universal). Privilege escalation-i askarlayir.
gpo_policy: Loglama - user management; Admin/qrup idareetmesi nezareti
expression: SELECT username, "TargetUserName", "TargetSid", "Event ID" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('4728','4732','4756') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: 'Event ID' is any of 4728, 4732, 4756. (Optional) Group Name ilike 'Admin'. Response: Dispatch New Event + Offense indexed by TargetUserName, Magnitude high.

name: QR_Rule_04: Use of Built-in Administrator (RID 500)
description: Daxili Administrator hesabinin (RID 500 / ad 'Administrator') istifadesi. GPO admin adinin deyisilmesini teleb etdiyi ucun bu hesabin istifadesi anomaliya/pozuntudur.
gpo_policy: Admin hesabinin adi mutleq deyisilmelidir (default 'Administrator' olmamalidir)
expression: SELECT username, "TargetUserName", "TargetSid", sourceip, "Event ID" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('4624','4672') AND ("TargetSid" LIKE '%-500' OR "TargetUserName"='Administrator') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: 'Event ID' is any of 4624,4672 AND (Target SID ends with -500 OR TargetUserName='Administrator'). Response: Dispatch New Event + Offense indexed by Username.

name: QR_Rule_05: Unauthorized RDP Logon (non Remote Desktop Admins)
description: Icaze verilmis siyahida (reference set) olmayan istifadecinin RDP (LogonType 10) ile girisi ve ya cehdinin askarlanmasi.
gpo_policy: RDP yalniz Remote Desktop Admins qrupuna; diger userler RDP ile qosula bilmemelidir
expression: SELECT username, sourceip, "LogonType", "Event ID" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('4624','4625') AND "LogonType"='10' AND username NOT IN (SELECT value FROM reference_data WHERE name='Authorized_RDP_Users') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Onceden 'Authorized_RDP_Users' reference set yarat. Test: 'Event ID' is any of 4624,4625 AND Logon Type = 10 AND Username NOT in Reference Set 'Authorized_RDP_Users'. Response: Dispatch New Event + Offense indexed by Username.

name: QR_Rule_06: Legacy NTLMv1 / LM Authentication
description: Zeif LM/NTLMv1 authentication paketinin istifadesi (downgrade). GPO bunlari sondurur: her hansi LM/NTLMv1 istifadesi pozuntu/hucum elametidir.
gpo_policy: LM ve NTLMv1 sondurulmeli; LM hash yadda saxlanilmamali
expression: SELECT username, sourceip, "AuthenticationPackageName", "LmPackageName", "Event ID" FROM events WHERE "Event ID"='4624' AND ("LmPackageName" ILIKE '%NTLM V1%' OR "LmPackageName" ILIKE '%LM%') LAST 10 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: 'Event ID' = 4624 AND (LmPackageName ilike 'LM' OR ilike 'NTLM V1'). Response: Dispatch New Event + Offense indexed by Source IP.

name: QR_Rule_07: Security Audit Log Cleared / Audit Policy Tampering
description: Audit log-un temizlenmesi (1102/104) ve ya audit siyasetinin deyisdirilmesi (4719). Klassik iz-itirme (anti-forensics) davranishi.
gpo_policy: Security Policy deyisiklikleri loglari aktiv; loglama strukturunun qorunmasi
expression: SELECT username, "Event ID", "Computer" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('1102','104','4719') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: 'Event ID' is any of 1102, 104, 4719. Response: Dispatch New Event + Offense indexed by Username, Magnitude very high.

name: QR_Rule_08: Suspicious / Obfuscated PowerShell Execution
description: Obfuscated/encoded PowerShell icrasi (Script Block 4104 ve ya Sysmon process create). -enc, -nop, bypass, hidden, DownloadString kimi elametler.
gpo_policy: PowerShell logging aktiv (Server); klientlerde PowerShell bloklanir
expression: SELECT username, "Image", "CommandLine", "Event ID" FROM events WHERE ("Event ID"='4104' OR qid=5000845) AND ("CommandLine" ILIKE '%-enc%' OR "CommandLine" ILIKE '%encodedcommand%' OR "CommandLine" ILIKE '%frombase64string%' OR "CommandLine" ILIKE '%downloadstring%' OR "CommandLine" ILIKE '%-nop%' OR "CommandLine" ILIKE '%bypass%' OR "CommandLine" ILIKE '%hidden%') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: ('Event ID'=4104 OR QID=Sysmon Process Create) AND CommandLine/ScriptBlock matches suspicious keywords. Response: Dispatch New Event + Offense indexed by Username/Computer.

name: QR_Rule_09: Removable USB Storage Device Connected
description: Xarici/removable disk qurgu tanindi (6416 Kernel-PnP, ve ya DriverFrameworks 2003/2102). GPO USB-ni bloklayir: her taxilma pozuntudur.
gpo_policy: Xarici diskler (USB flash, HDD, SSD) sisteme taxilmasi qadagan
expression: SELECT username, "Computer", "ClassName", "Event ID" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('6416','2003','2102') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: 'Event ID' is any of 6416, 2003, 2102 (ve ya Device Class = DiskDrive/USB). Response: Dispatch New Event + Offense indexed by Computer.

name: QR_Rule_10: Office Macro / Windows Script Host Child Process (LOLBIN)
description: Office tetbiqinin (Word/Excel/Outlook) shell/skript (cmd/powershell/wscript/cscript/mshta) yaratmasi (makro hucumu), ve ya WSH (wscript/cscript) icrasi. Sysmon EventID 1 ve ya Security 4688.
gpo_policy: Makro bloklanir + Protected View; Windows Script Host sondurulur; CMD bloklanir
expression: SELECT "Image", "ParentImage", "CommandLine", "Computer" FROM events WHERE qid=5000845 AND (("ParentImage" ILIKE '%winword.exe' OR "ParentImage" ILIKE '%excel.exe' OR "ParentImage" ILIKE '%powerpnt.exe' OR "ParentImage" ILIKE '%outlook.exe') AND ("Image" ILIKE '%cmd.exe' OR "Image" ILIKE '%powershell.exe' OR "Image" ILIKE '%wscript.exe' OR "Image" ILIKE '%cscript.exe' OR "Image" ILIKE '%mshta.exe') OR "Image" ILIKE '%wscript.exe' OR "Image" ILIKE '%cscript.exe') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: QID = Sysmon Process Create AND ((ParentImage is Office app AND Image is shell/script) OR Image is wscript/cscript). Response: Dispatch New Event + Offense indexed by Computer.
